inputs.name: services
inputs.description: Which of Presidio's services to run: "analyzer", which finds PII in text, and "anonymizer", which replaces what the analyzer found.

inputs.name: presidio_version
inputs.description: Tag of the ghcr.io/data-privacy-stack/presidio-analyzer and presidio-anonymizer images, such as "2.2.366". Change analyzer_digest and anonymizer_digest with it.

inputs.name: analyzer_digest
inputs.description: Digest of presidio-analyzer for presidio_version. Podman pulls by the digest, so a tag that moves upstream can't change what runs.

inputs.name: anonymizer_digest
inputs.description: Digest of presidio-anonymizer for presidio_version. Podman pulls by the digest, so a tag that moves upstream can't change what runs.

inputs.name: listen_address
inputs.description: Address both services listen on. Presidio has no authentication, so the default keeps it on the host. Anything else gets a warning on every plan.

inputs.name: analyzer_config
inputs.description: The analyzer's configuration as YAML, in Presidio's single-file format: supported_languages, default_score_threshold, and optional nlp_configuration and recognizer_registry sections. A recognizer_registry section replaces the built-in list of recognizers. When null, the image's defaults: English, with every built-in recognizer.
